risk_note: RV2 (admin console authorization boundary, BR-ID-34 step-up tiers). Step-up on the admin entry: totp tier via the F1-06b verifier and PG replay store, sms tier via the identity SmsSender port (code hash stored before sending, rejected sends withdrawn, unknown outcomes kept, 60 s per-account resend limit with 42901, 24 h history of sent-code hashes so voided or expired codes answer 20003), wrong codes 20002 counted into the login lock; one-time opaque step-up token in Redis bound to admin, session, app and tier (tiers must match), consumed only on 2xx and code=0, single success under concurrency; permission guard exported for later admin routes (10403 admin_permission_denied, 10003 data.tier, verify_phone_missing); GET me/permissions (super gets all points, others the ticked ones, empty when none) with tiers from specs/permissions.yaml (04 §11, keys equal to the admin_permission enum). Three contract operations leave planned. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
